I spent two months studying Italian at Accademia Leonardo in Salerno, and I absolutely recommend this language school to anyone wishing to learn or improve their Italian at any level. The location is beautiful (directly across from the stunning gardens in the Villa Comunale).

The staff and teachers are unfailingly friendly, energetic, and helpful. In addition to providing high quality language instruction, they made themselves available to me throughout the summer, answering questions I had about Salerno or local travel and helping with details and any difficulties I had during the course of my stay. By the end of the summer I felt that they were friends.

All of the teachers are excellent, but I had an especially positive experience with Erika, who was my (superb) teacher for most of the summer and who went out of her way to provide lessons that were uniquely suited to my level. Mario is likewise wonderful--always friendly and welcoming. He went well beyond anything I could have expected from the school, helping to organize and coordinate lessons and providing suggestions and recommendations throughout my stay in Salerno.

It is a warm community with an excellent location in a stunningly beautiful city. I absolutely recommend it.

Great school. Well organized and very close to the sea. Tropea is a wonderful place and the school helped me immerse myself in the Italian Culture while I was there . I specially loved my teacher Fabiana for her gracious and thoughtful way of treating her students. Alla prossima, amici da PUI a Tropea!

This is the best of all the language schools I have attended in Italy, a total of eight different schools.  Classes are limited to eight students; some schools have 12 or more students per class.  The teachers and staff are exceptional, especially Enza!  Excursions were interesting, too.  Tropea is a beautiful town--stare at the sea and become mesmerized by it.  I will return in October 2026 for the third time at Piccola Università.
The PUI in Tropea is a very well organizer language school. I enjoyed the lessons, the excursions, the evening programs. The accommodation was large and cool,  5 minutes from the School.

This is the third time I’ve participated in an immersive Italian language school and it might be my favorite so far. The staff and teachers could not be nicer. You truly feel like part of a (big) family when you’re there. And the teachers are very gifted in their ability to connect with the students and teach the language. They clearly have a love for language studies.

The location of the school is nestled right in the city center — truly feels like Calabria when you’re in class with the breeze and natural light coming into the classrooms.

I loved every moment of my time here and can’t wait to return one day. Grazie mille a tutti alla Piccola Università Tropea!

Excellent school in a wonderful part of the world. Teachers are so motivated and helpful. The social programme is great and the locals are friendly and let you practice your Italian. The city has lots of places to eat and shop and close to many places to visit! Can't recommend enough!

I had been studying there B2 and C1 Italian language for foreigners, passed internal exams and Plida afterwards. Very good teachers, huge thanks to Santina and Giusella, it's not only about language and culture, it's about atmosphere as well. The courses are good.
Poorly organized. The tourist guide they have for the excursions hits and says absurd things to the ladies. Expensive and def not worth it.

Lazy, disorganized, absolute mess. They ran out of teachers so gave us a MATH teacher, who we had to correct…because she kept teaching us in Calabrese dialect! We also had 32 students in our class. Avoid this southern low-brow inept school. Yes I did complain…I was told that “if I didn’t like it, GO HOME THEN!” Oh my gosh…diabolical.

Bad service and attention. I did 2 courses here, the first was good, but too much students; the second was very bad; They did not answer my questions about when it would start, they did not acknowledge receipt of payment.
Once they started, they changed teachers, they repeated themes.
I made a query via email, to obtain information about the courses and they answered me very badly, with a response in capital letters; I had previously checked your website and it is also not up to date and the response to my email inquiry was rude.
Definitely do not recommend :(

It was in 1990-91, I was there for 9 months but not in this building but the first one.I learned italian speedily with the help of the teachers and very welcoming attitude of the locals. una bella parte della mia vita,ho passato la.Grazie mille!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I cannot recommend Scuola Porta d'Oriente highly enough! Barbara is a phenomenal teacher whose infectious energy made learning both fun and incredibly effective.
Instead of dry lectures, the course content was practical, modern, and engaging.

Barbara created a highly interactive environment, ensuring we were speaking, participating, and truly involved from day one. She has a true gift for drawing students out of their shells.

The absolute highlight was the cultural immersion. The day trips we took to explore the rich history of Salento were unforgettable, allowing us to practice our Italian out in the real world while experiencing the beauty of the region.

My confidence in speaking Italian skyrocketed in just a week. Grazie mille, Barbara, for an exceptional experience!

This was my third language immersion school and I must say that the experience was fantastic.
For starters, Otranto is such a lovely town, full of life and energy. There are plenty of places to explore and restaurants to enjoy fresh seafood and delicious farm to table vegetables and fruits.
The school was really nice and the classes were small which helps a lot if you are trying to have a full immersion.
We learned to make pasta and desserts with fresh ingredients we bought at the open market. Students and teachers shared culinary knowledge and wisdom, all in Italian. :)
My most memorable experience was without a doubt being in class with our teacher Barbara. Her passion and dedication for education are palpable. She wanted us to learn the language without sacrificing the essence of human knowledge, therefore, she made us think and express ourselves freely.
We visited historical sites, dissected movies, songs, commercials and shared life experiences with her as a guiding light.
Grazie cara Barbara, e ci vedremo molto presto!

I recently attended classes here and it was a fantastic experience. Patrizia is a great teacher; I heard from other students that Barbara is as well. We studied the language in a communicative format and I was really happy with the improvement in my skills. We also discussed culture, traditions, the local area, etc. and I felt like all of the students bonded with one another over our shared experience. Otranto is a beautiful city with so much to see and do. I can't recommend it enough and I will return.

An enjoyable and productive two weeks. Barbara understood perfectly how to adapt to the needs and interests of an international group. We discussed a great variety of topics, watched films and visited places of interest. My Italian has definitely improved along with my knowledge of the Salento region!

I took a conversational course in Otranto, with Scuola d’Oriente. Since the very first communication Barbara was very responsive, patient and detailed in her responses. I stayed with a local woman and did the homestay option which honestly was the best decision ever. I was fully immersed in the language and the culture. The lessons at the school were so interesting and time flew by. We practiced the language while we learned a lot about the culture and the place. I cannot recommend this place enough. I will definitely come back!
Beautiful setting with good service, fabulous food and great local wines.  Would recommend.

I've been taking courses at Babilonia since a couple of years now, and I always return because of the experienced teachers and the lovely atmosphere at school. The combination of learning the language in class, and having the opportunity to practice it during lunch in the lovely garden...it doesn't get any better! The restaurant is just amazing, and the staff very charming as well. They even offer cooking classes. I've tried other language schools before and I can truly say, Babilonia is one of a kind!
I completed a language course. Loved every moment. Loved my teacher Marina and met some great people. Highly recommend

I spent 7 weeks studying at Babilonia last summer. I'd originally booked myself for only 4 weeks, so you might guess how much I enjoyed my time there.

The staff were always kind and helpful. Instructors were fun, engaging and adept at meeting individual students' needs. Lessons emphasized speaking as much as possible, whatever your level, unlike any previous instruction I'd had elsewhere. The school itself is in a garden oasis in the middle of arguably one of the most beautiful little coastal towns you might want to visit.

I highly recommend studying the Italian language (& culture!) here. You will inevitably come away with much more than improved vocabulary.

I spent two weeks at the Babilonia language school as a beginner and I am thrilled. We students were always encouraged to speak Italian, even if it wasn't right yet. As a result, I always dared to speak Italian and give it a try, which was helpful for the progress. The teachers are patient and always explain creatively and clearly if you don't understand something. The atmosphere was warm and we had a lot of fun during the lessons. I am very happy to have chosen Babilonia. Many thanks to my two teachers Michela and Giorgio!

I spent four weeks studying here in March. It was a fantastic experience. The school is small which allows for a lot of personal attention. The teachers are excellent, the administrators are kind, and the other students are very engaged and warm. A couple of the students are there for the long haul so if you study there in 2026 you’ll definitely get the welcome wagon. Couldn’t recommend more highly!

I spent one week in an intensive intermediate course in Italian at Laboling with Rosalba. She is a very good instructor, well-prepared but also spontaneous. She has some good ways of getting students to implement what they have learned. The class was challenging for me because I was not as advanced as the other two students, but it was very worthwhile. I am inspired to continue studying at home. The school is in a good location in the town of Milazzo, which is picturesque and has good hiking opportunities in town and nearby. Everyone at the school was very friendly and helpful.

Excellent, I was there for 3 weeks and I improved tremendously (a lot of conversation in the lessons), teachers and staff are all very competent but also adorable, the location is great if you want a laid back town from where you can visit the amazing Eolian Islands (and many other places around Sicily), and everybody in town is extremely friendly. I really recommend it.

I cannot say enough good things about my 4-week learning experience at Laboling! The learning experience was challenging, yet so rewarding with the great teachers I had - Chiara and Elvira! Sonja and Rosalba are to be commended for such a well run school! They showed such kind and gracious Sicilian hospitality! Best of all, its setting, Milazzo, is such a picturesque location. The learning combined with extracurricular activities and field trips was one of the most rewarding travel adventures I've had. If you want to learn Italian in the most beautiful setting, I highly recommend Laboling!

I've always been interested in Italian language and Sicilian culture.  So when I retired in 2021 I started researching the language schools in Sicily.  There were numerous options for a 50+ course.  I chose the one offered by Laboling in October of 2021 and I'm glad that I did! The entire staff was extremely gracious, accommodating, and patient. Their kindness started before the 50+ course began. Covid was still a threat at the time.  I left the States on a Thursday and was to arrive in Milazzo Friday evening. However, after two flight cancellations I was still in Rome when my arranged pickup was in Catania. I finally arrived in Milazzo on Sunday evening.  During that two day delay, the congeniality of the Laboling staff never faltered. The accommodations in the shared flat were a throwback to my college days.  Getting to know my flatmates was a cultural experience in itself. The two week 50+ course was absolutely fabulous (I decided to say longer). The planned excursions were led by the staff, who were not only great teachers but also excellent tour guides - second to none.  Not sure who took the pic - hello to all!

We were there for two weeks, May 25 and June 1, 2026. I was in the beginner class (A1). We were 3 students the first week and added 1 more in the second week. Our teachers Elda and Davide were great. Patient with us, speaking a lot of Italian but also helping us understand sometimes in English. We covered a lot. Definite and indefinite articles (il, la, lo, gli, …), conjugation of important verbs like to have and to be (avere e essere), the verb to do (fare) important phrases, lots of vocabulary, the present tense, many many verbs ending in are, ere, ir. We dealt with exceptions. Lots of exercises in class and games. Lots of laughs. A light amount of homework (exercises out of class). We made a lot of friends and so had outings for many an apertif in the beautiful Cefalu and suppers after where we could practice our Italian and have a good time. Of course you get out of it what you put into it. It has motivated us to continue our efforts to learn Italian back in Montreal. The administrative staff are very friendly. Giuseppe was helpful in making suggestions of where to visit on a weekend trip to Palermo and Valeria is never without a smile. We may very well return next year to continue our learning. Cefalu is magical.

There is a wonderful friendly atmosphere at Solemar. Marco and Simona are expert and passionate teachers. Aside from the sea and the beautiful city of Cefalu itself, it is close to a number of other fascinating places. The school makes it simple for students to befriend one another while learning the language. It is no surprise that there are many repeat students like me..All’Accademia Solemar, se avete la fortuna di frequentarla, troverete amici con le vostre stesse passioni. Un grazie di cuore a tutti al Solemar!

My wife and I attended Solemar for 6 weeks as part of a Roadscholar program. Cefalu was wonderful but the classes at Solemar were the best part of the trip. The teachers were extremely skilled at all levels of instruction. They were engaging, interesting, and entertaining. The staff was professional and responsive. Our language skills improved dramatically but the whole experience was more like fun than work.

Solemar Academy put me right to work, and supported my attempt to learn Italiano . No wonder I feel so positive the vibes were built in with the staff!! I loved the the young professional all around they affected my psyche... like a pep rally in my head!, It affects the whole experience.   The bonus is Cefula" and its beautiful surroundings.

Solemar Academy is an excellent language school full of professional and caring teachers. My husband and I just finished 6 wonderful weeks of Italian Language classes there, as Road Scholar students, with Simona as our instructor. She also taught us about the culture, food, and history of Sicily. Solemar sponsors many extra events we enjoyed, including a wine tasting, many Italian films, a puppet opera, and a visit to a cheese making farm. We met many other students and teachers at the Academy and enjoyed them tremendously. It was truly a life-enriching experience!
Classroom with poor visibility and poor audio.
Friendly staff

I have just finished another fabulous course at Scuola Virgilia in Trapani. Firstly, Trapani is a wonderful small city in which to study the Italian language. It has everything that you could possibly want as a foreigner to live the Italian life for a few weeks-beautiful beaches, a Baroque historic center, Erice-a medieval walled town a public bus and funicular ride away, the Egadi Islands on your doorstep, an arts festival throughout the year for concerts and operas and the most warm hearted people you will ever encounter. Scuola Virgilio is a fantastic school with vibrant teachers who care about their subject and their students. The learning is vigorous and students are rewarded with constantly improved Italian. The school makes a lot of effort to connect the students outside of learning hours with people through fun activities including city walks, aperitivo night, museum visits, art gallery visits, cooking demonstrations. Having just finished my second course at Sculoa Virgilio, it was wonderful to meet up with students who I studied with last year and to meet past students who now live in Trapani at the Aperitivo Night (where I was invited to perform Sicilian songs on a rooftop bar by the school staff). So fun!!!  Trapani is now a place where I have friends and I know each time I return, that I will make more friends.  I have studied Italian in larger cities and I can't stress enough how Trapani and its wonderful language school Scuola Virgilio is an excellent choice for those tossing up where to study. With Palermo Airport and Trapani Birgi Airport both a short and inexpensive bus ride away, why wouldn't you come here.

Kirsten (Australia)
I did an enjoyable one week Intermediate Italian course in April 2025 at Scuola Virgilio, Trapani. The teaching is excellent and I would not hesitate to recommend this school.

I had a great time with and in „Scuola Virgilio“ and with the lovely family, they organized for me to stay in. I stayed there for two months in the summer and such as i had a very intense experience, culturally and in classes. I signed up for the „Au - Pair workexperience“ and after Stefano kindly organized everything, i ended up in a very warming family, with two lovely kids, or more like teenagers (they had the most fun at teaching me themselves more italian, as well as learning some difficult german words from me). The parents were very caring around their kids and had a program planned at all times in the evening and the weekends. And i could always join them, with their boat, to their big family meetings, and so on. I had a great time meeting many very nice locals, learning much about trapanese food and culture, as well as seeing the most beautiful places. And in the end, they even let my brother stay at their place for free.
The school, led by Stefano is also a lovely place, where you immediately feel welcomed by everyone and where everyone takes care of you, if something’s up. The teachers are very passionate about their job and each one has their own technique on how they teach you. All definitely effective, which i noticed after two months of intense learning.:)) I started out as a total beginner, with almost no experience and could have small talk in the end. Right now i‘m taking another course at university and i have a quick understanding of things, because i learned so much at scuola virgilio. :)) The only critique would be, that especially in the beginning of my course the classes changed a lot and with that also the speaking level of the students. Sometimes i could‘nt quite keep up with the rest of the class. But that‘s something, where the school cannot have so much control over, considering that at least during my stay there were only two classes taken and that most people stayed for one or two weeks only. And despite that, the teacher Daniela and Daniela :), who teached me during my course were doing their best to consider everyone’s level and find creative ways to keep us motivated, even though it was very hot often times. A big „grazie mille“ to them!! Also to Stefano, who i could always talk to if there was anything going on and who did great walking tours through the city almost every week, where i didn‘t always understand everything, but still had a good time. Besides, the school program every week was all in all great… my highlight was the winetasting at a small winery close to Trapani.
All in all, i highly recommend „scuola virgilio“ for everyone who likes to learn this beautiful language, even from the start and get to know the Sicilian culture more!

Scuola Virgilio is an Italian language school based  the vibrant and fascinating city of Trapani western Sicily. It is off the beaten track and found it to be very interesting to see another side of Sicily away from the popular tourist areas. The school is centrally located and provides everything needed for an enjoyable experience.
Thank you Stefano and your staff for creating a supportive and empowering  learning environment which I found to be conducive to learning.
I am learning Italian for pleasure and my objective was to have the opportunity to gain more confidence in speaking the language. I feel I have achieved this thanks to the encouragement and opportunities provided by you and your team and also the interaction with my classmates.
The walking tour of Marsala with Chiara is not to be missed.

Curlette
May 2023

The high quality teachers and personal attention at Scuola Virgilio make it an an exceptional place to learn Italian. The private classes were geared perfectly to my language level and shaped to include information about my interests in Sicilian culture. While learning Italian I also learned about Sicily and Sicilians in conversations about food, art, history, and more. I learned so much! Every lesson was fantastic, and I also enjoyed going to a social organized by the school. Hosted by the school at a local bar, the social offered the chance to spend time with the teachers outside of class and to get to know fellow students, students of all ages. Fun! If you're looking for a place to learn Italian, sign up for a class with Scuola Virgilio and build a vacation around it exploring beautiful Trapani with the sea right there plus wonderful shops and restaurants. I just loved all of it and give the school my highest recommendation.

My wife and I were at the school for four weeks, and it exceeded our expectations in every way.  Learning a language and living in town close by allows for an experience much closer to “living there” as opposed to just visiting and ticking off a box on a travel itinerary.  This is exactly what we wanted.  You feel part of the place, and make real local connections.  It is such a welcoming environment.  This is a high quality experience and we recommend it highly!

An unforgettable experience.. 3 weeks of Italian classes with excellent teachers, with great themes, always paying attention to our interests, learning needs. Small groups allow deep immersion, afternoon/evening programs organised by the school enhanced the group cohesion and fluent conversation in Italian. Loved every minute of it! Many thanks Maria Rosa, Marco, Eleonora and the whole team!

It’s not often that you come across a place that feels so right, a place that aligns in whatever you need in life, a place that complements you at that moment in life. This was the case for me.

I first came Pintadera Italian language school almost two and a half years ago - late August 2023. This return in February 2025, marks my third time here.

I should start at the beginning. I was searching for an adventure, a cultural immersion, a place where I could delve into the Italian language, which I had grappled with in a hotchpotch kind of way never securing a commitment nor a want to learn. That all changed when I enrolled in Pintadera school.

The school is situated in Centro Storica (the old part of town) smack bang in the bustling life of Alghero.

The first contact, Nicola, drew me in with a genuine care and consideration for who I was, at that stage a stranger, but the correspondence was personal and of great attention. Before I knew it, I was enrolled in a four week Italian course at the school. I was excited!  I was looking forward to this new adventure in life and I couldn’t imagine how life changing this experience would be!

That first four weeks were filled with so many life lived experiences. I had lessons by day including a pausa in the middle of the two lessons in which bonded the friendships that were made through these weeks. Afternoons were filled with many activities ranging from sailing boat cruises at sunset, dolphin spotting cruises, drinks with new found friends, dinners, excursions to other parts of Sardegna, cooking experiences, tasting and making traditional Sardegnan food, weekly drinks with students, attending opera nights, seeing live music, eating gelato as well as a treasure of so many more experiences. All priceless, many coordinated by the school and all have lead to making lifelong friends.

I should mention the actual learning at school, which was quite incredible as well. The morning sessions comprised of grammar learning followed by a break where coffee was on the menu and for some a cornetto or two, followed by another session of conversation. The unique way that the school engaged the students throughout my time there was commendable.

Nicola and Angela and the way that they ran the admin side of the school and the interaction with students really highlighted how the school was unique to others. The brilliant, hands on and engaging teachers were highly professional and attended to the needs of the individual students. The curriculum was such that it highlighted the necessary grammar and cultural studies were interwoven in the second sessions during a plethora of speaking activities.

All in all incredible experiences that have been built upon during the three times I have been here. Two of the times August 2023 and September 2024 were warmer months where many activities involved outdoor type of experiences. This time around it is February 2025 and the weather is quite different in that it is colder and there are less people in the town, which can be a bonus, but that doesn’t take away from the language learning at Pintadera. The classes are small, but smaller classes during these winter months allow for a more unique personalised program to cater for the needs of the individual students.

What makes this school special? In my opinion and during my three times here I felt like I was returning home to visit friends and family. It is a very special school that welcome everyone and caters for the needs of every person whether you’re a beginner, or someone like me così così or an expert speaker of the language.

Pintadera is the school for you if you want to learn Italian but at the same time want a place that feels like home, knows who you as well as being a special place where you can learn with people that will become new friends. Its uniqueness caters for all and is definitely the school to learn Italian. What better place to learn than at Pintadera Language school in Alghero Sardegna, where the beauty of the place enhances the individuality of the school!
Rosie

I really enjoyed my time at Pintadera language school.  I learned so much and met some great people.  Nicola goes out of her way to make sure that you have the opportunity to make new friends from not just your own class, but others as well.  The school location is fantastic; right in the center of the historic area.  Alghero, the town, is really pretty. It’s right on the water and everything you need is within walking distance.  I was there in the off season and took the long term course.  The class sizes were great and the pace and learning was tailored to the group.
I was also in Sardinia in order to apply for my Italian citizenship via “jure sanguinis”.  I’m super happy to say that not only can I now speak some Italian (I’m improving daily) but I am a dual Italian American citizen as well. I could not have done this without Nicola, Angela, and Pintadera’s help.
I highly recommend you come visit Alghero and learn Italian while you are here!

I have been there twice and would always go back! This little school with beautiful rooms and a personal atmosphere is located in the beautiful old town of Alghero. The teachers are helpful and always tailor their lessons to their student's needs. Groups are small and therefore you are able to speak a lot in class. Angela and Nicola, the school leaders, are both very nice and super helpful with any questions you might have.
If you enjoy some program during your vacation and really want to get to know some of Sardinia's best people, Pintadera might just be the place for you!
Great language school! I’ve been doing 1-1 classes online for 7 months and I’m very happy with my progress, the teaching method, and the client attention provided by One World Language Center.

If you're going to be in Cagliari for more than a few days, I recommend you contact this school first. They can help you find cheaper lodging options and also help you with much more than just the Italian language (e.g., transportation, parking information, moving to Sardinia, interesting sites, dealing with the local government, help with filling out residency forms, working in Sardinia, etc., and any other questions that you may have about life in Cagliari or Sardinia). Kind and helpful folks. I learned much more than just the language.

Carla è una brava insegnante. Il proprietario David è molto gentile. La scuola è bella con una bellissima vista.

Outstanding Language Learning Experience at One World -
I had a truly enriching and unforgettable experience at One World. The teachers are enthusiastic, attentive, and create a warm, engaging atmosphere that makes learning so enjoyable. The course is thoughtfully structured and well-balanced, integrating listening, writing, speaking, and grammar with high-quality content. I wholeheartedly recommend One World and look forward to returning soon to continue my studies. Congratulations to the entire team! A presto!

I thoroughly enjoyed my 4 weeks at this school. Great teachers and activities offered outside of class. I was also perfectly matched with a host family that gave me great opportunities to practice speaking outside of class. Would love to return one day

I am a tour leader who led a group of 15 people on a three week Italian language tour to the One World school in Cagliari. The school was excellent. The tuition was of a very high quality, the staff friendly and helpful, and the location near the port easy to get to. Highly recommended.
We went here twice during our stay in Florence-lovely staff, beautiful views and great drinks! Thank you!
I took a week long class with Sarah and Ilaria and they were so kind and welcoming. They helped me ease into the Italian language and I was able to learn so much in a compressed timeline.

The teachers at the language school are very friendly and always strive to provide a varied and enriching experience. They were also always available to help with health or organizational issues. In addition to the interesting lessons, there were excursions, and you could help shape the school's program according to your own interests and needs. Of all the language courses I've taken, this was the best! I highly recommend it!

Pupils are welcomed and accommodated  from the get go, to throughout the entire course.
Competent, professional and caring teachers, proficiently sustaining the students  are some of the many qualities that make this school highly recommended.

I've took several courses (mainly in foreign languages) here with some of my friends and really loved the experience. The school is near the centre of Florence so after the courses we used to spend the rest of day visiting the city. I would recommend taking a course here to whoever wants to spend a beautiful time in a wonderful city while learning one more language or two!

Important note: The rating was given for the Italian language courses (which are great!), however some warning about the housing:

The school offers to help you find a room (in an apartment of a local family) that you can stay in during your time in Florence.
Please make sure to get some pictures of the room you are renting before agreeing to the price! I payed about 260€ for a 6m² room. The ceiling in the room was barely high enough to stand up straight (if you are taller than 1.80m) and the walls were so thin that you could hear everything coming from the living area.
In my opinion the price was way to high and the school should ask this family to stop renting out this room or make the stay way cheaper.

The school itself is great. All the teachers I have met are friendly and compentent. This year has already been the second time I booked an Italian language course and there might be a third time :). The school is also nicely located (very close to a bar, a small super market, a park and restaurants), also the price for the courses is, in my opinion, very fair.

I've just returned home after a lovely stay in Florence. Classes in Italian at Centro Italiano Firenze was a high point of my trip. After studying for two weeks in a private class I feel I'm actually getting somewhere with my Italian. I plan to keep it up with online classes. Then next year I hope to return again for more one on one study. My classes were very well structured and I had a most professional, friendly and energetic teacher. Keep up the great work to all the staff. I'll see you next year!

Il Centro Italiano Firenze is a great place to learn Italian.  The office staff are welcoming, and kind.  They are willing to help in any way they can, even if it doesn't involve learning Italian. They make it a point to make sure your experience in Florence is positive.
I was able to experience several of the teachers. I appreciated each one for their unique style.  Class sizes are small and often I was on my own.
I wasn't learning so much from a prescribed text, instead, each instructor would come to class with interesting material tailored to and prepared to meet me at my level.
A bonus for students attending the Centro was the weekly outing that a teacher would take students on.
The school can also connect students with other courses outside of language learning.  These classes offer students a chance to use and expand on their Italian and find new interests.
I attended school for 18 weeks and came away very satisfied.

I have taken an intensive italian lesson program for a full week end of october 2019. The team was really nice, the location of the classroom is perfect, right in the center of quartiere sant’ambrogio, easy to go to and with lots of very nice coffee and typical restaurants to take the lunch break. The teacher really took the Time to assess my italian level and adjust the courses according to my needs and objectives. I really enjoyed the teaching approach: mixing grammar lessons, with live practice, readings etc and switching from one another during thé course to ensure that students do not get bored. I really enjoyed my exchanges with the teacher, open minded, funny and easy going. The lessons are exclusively in italian, no explanations in english ensuring a full immersion week!

Great school which kicked started my path to learning Italian! I completed a 1 month beginners language course here in July 2019 which I definitely recommend. They taught me all the basics needed for everyday life and gave me basic skills to continue learning on my own. I wish I could have stayed longer! My father and sister are now planning to do the same course i completed in 2020.

Highly recommended! I've been learning with Francesco for the past two months. I originally wanted to take daily group lessons, but they weren't currently being offered. However, I probably learned significantly more with his two weekly private lessons than I would have in a traditional language school. Francesco is a very experienced and competent language teacher who connects with his students with empathy and passion. He not only excels in his teaching methods but, above all, makes his lessons very entertaining, engaging, and humorous. I enjoyed every minute!

The best of the best!😍 i had an amazing time, Francesco showed me many beautiful places, we always had a blast . It is nice to learn the language with someone who has a passion for the culture and the beautiful island sardinia.

I had a really great time during my one-week Italian standard course at Studitalia in Olbia! Francesco, who leads the school and also teaches himself, is a highly motivating, very talented and super friendly teacher. Under his care, even the toughest grammar exercises become a very enjoyable activity :) Besides the lessons, he also organized excursions into the awesome Costa Smeralda area. Thus, I can only strongly recommend the Studitalia Language School to whoever wants to study Italian in lovely Sardegna!

I've been attending this school regularly for two years now, and I'm always thrilled. Francesco, the owner, even manages to teach Italian grammar with humor. 😉 Back home, I have a weekly Skype lesson, which works perfectly. The weekly excursions are also always wonderful, giving you a great insight into the country and its people. For me, it's clear: Studitalia and Sardinia are the place to be again and again.

Francesco, the director and teacher, makes the lessons very interesting and varied. As an excellent language teacher, you learn Italian almost effortlessly. The additional leisure activities are also diverse, ranging from hikes and excursions to... Highly recommended.

I signed up for Truilli school knowing that in a smaller town people would not be speaking English as much as in the larger cities. I loved the idea of combining school with afternoon immersive trips. Truilli school truly exceeded my expectations. The teachers were incredible ( Angelica 🥰 ) , the perfect combination of challenging yet doable for our beginners class of over 50’s . The trips to nearby towns were lots of fun and showcased the beauty of Puglia . The masseria cooking afternoon was amazing.
The town of Alberobello worked its magic with welcoming apartment owners, shopkeepers and caffes( bar unico, bar 88 grande) and great restaurants ( terra madre).
What i was not expecting was the camaraderie of our group.     I learned some Italian  and made 14 new friends from around the world.
I would not hesitate to recommend this school to anyone.
Andrea, Elisabetta,  the teachers, the town.
It was a fabulous experience. Perfetto . Grazie Truilli School and Alberobello.

Absolutely amazing school to learn Italian - I have been to several schools in Italy before, and this was by far the best school I have ever been to. Andrea my teacher was really fabulous! I had 10 excellent private lessons with him and he was really fun, friendly, professional, encouraging, and very well prepared for each lesson.  He is really accommodating as well in tailoring the lessons to learn exactly what is needed as well as what you want.  We played very entertaining games but they were also games which were well thought out because they helped us to get to know each other better.  At the same time, the games also set the scene for the lessons by building trust and good rapport between us, such that I felt very comfortable with him to try hard to use all the Italian that I learnt during the lessons, and even though I made mistakes I still felt confident enough to continue. Andrea teaches really well too and explains everything with great precision.  He helped me fix my biggest grammar issues which I had struggled with before for a long time by going through it methodically, and helping me practice using many examples.  Overall, Andrea is a really cool, fun, engaging and wonderful teacher - we had lessons full of laughter and I am really happy to have had the opportunity to attend his absolutely fantastic school.  I have to mention also that Elisabeta the coordinator is also a really lovely person, and although I had forgotten to enrol until the last minute, she and Andrea absolutely went out of their way to help organise my lessons for me to ensure that I was able to have lessons.  All the amazing reviews of this school are true - I had the best time with Andrea, learnt so much and I will definitely be back for more lessons the next time I am in Alberobello!!

Thoroughly enjoyed the week at Scuola Trulli.  Animated and friendly instructors, well planned class exercises, afternoon trips to other small cities with guidance of Andrea et al. were amazing.  The cooking class was unexpectedly a high point for me since I do not cook much at home.  I learned new language skills but also about the culture and realized I will need a longer stay to truly advance my spoken Italian.  La prossima volta!  Each student had rich lives and as a group I thought we had a great dynamic.  I attribute that in good part to the structure and support Andrea and his team provided.  Thank you!

I really enjoyed my two weeks in Alberobello on this full immersion Italian language course. Lessons were all morning and there were cultural trips to local towns / cookery / wine tastings every afternoon. It was really fun and my spoken Italian certainly improved. Quite a range of abilities in my class, there were 8-10 of us in the classes. The teaching was high calibre and the teachers made it a fun and interactive experience. Alberobello is a very pretty town to stay in for 2 weeks and my appt was arranged by the school. The other learners in the group were very friendly and there were lots of social evenings and dinners spent together. I would recommend Trulli Italian School.

The Trulli School truly exceeded my expectations. The staff is warm, friendly, and extremely helpful, especially Elisabetta, who responds to questions immediately and ensures you have all you need prior to arrival, upon arrival, during your stay, and when you sadly depart. My teacher, Elisa, was funny, intelligent, and engaging, making all of us semi-beginners extremely comfortable and helping us to become more confident speakers as the days went by. Andrea is running a truly special school, and he clearly enjoys sharing his language and culture with his students. The afternoon and weekend excursions were spectacular: visits to beautiful seaside towns and historic cities, wine tasting, olive oil tasting and a cooking class followed by a celebratory dinner… Bellissimo! This was my first immersive language experience, and I would recommend it to anyone who is looking to enrich their study of the Italian language while having unforgettable experiences and meeting new friends from around the world.
My personalized English course with you was wonderful. Your professionalism and flexibility were admirable.
I really enjoyed all the lessons! Teresa is a very good and friendly teacher:)

I took 20 online lessons with Teresa and I had an amazing experience. Teresa is a very patient and caring teacher, who puts effort in her students development and learning. I really enjoyed each lesson with her, she is very professional. In only 20 lessons I learned a lot. Grazie, Teresa! :)

We were very lucky to find this language school! We not only fell in love with Grottaglie, which is a remarkable place to stay with a most attractive centro storico with an amazing amount of bars and ristorante. But most fortunately was to be taught by Teresa. She is a very competent teacher who offers a lot of different ways to learn a language. The lessons were adapted to our level. We are absolute beginners, but  learned a lot in a few days and had  a good time: molto divertente. We also got to know a lot about italian culture and customs, the italian way of life, Grottaglie and the sights in the area worthwhile visiting. Teresa is a very friendly person and quickly suceeds in establishing a relaxing and  fruitful learning atmosphere. As we are very slow learners – at the age of almost 70 – we appreciate her endless patience.
Hopefully we can return next year!

Coming from an English country I was put one year behind in the Italian high school due to my difficulties in Italian. We contacted Teresa from the Punto e Virgola school and she quickly brought me up to a hight enough level of Italian to pass to my correct year in school. Teresa is an excellent teacher with lots of positive energy, very patient, understanding and with an excellent knowledge of teaching languages. I found myself not only quickly expanding my level of Italian but also learning more about the Italian culture. I highly recommend Teresa, Punto e Virgola, for anybody that needs to learn or increase their knowledge of the Italian language.

This is simply the best school/teacher for foreigners to learn italian. Teresa has not only had an excellent education in teaching, she is also a gifted teacher, patient, humorous and professional. I learned a lot in a short time owing to her systematic and clear ways. I am looking forward to coming back

I attended ARCA italian language school from February to July 2026. The school is located on a pretty street in the center area of Bologna.  Classes were Monday through Friday from 9 am to 1 pm with a 1/2 hour coffee break at 11 am.  The teachers are excellent at teaching grammar and leading practice in italian conversation.  The classes are each geared to the level of the student from beginner to very advanced. My experience at ARCA was excellent.

I absolutely loved Arca!
The teachers are highly professional, and the lessons are engaging and never feel like traditional school classes.
It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, especially during the activities and the daily coffee break when everyone gets together.
The school is also perfectly located in the center of Bologna.
Another great advantage is its flexibility: you can enroll week by week, with no long-term commitment.
Highly recommended!

I cannot recommend this school enough. I spent nearly 4 months studying here. These teachers are brilliant, patient and experts at teaching Italian to all levels. I was fortunate to experience lessons in my time from all of the teachers, they consistently provided a safe, welcoming space that was so enjoyable to learn within. Thank you Roberta, Corrina, Sara, Serafina, Erica, Ludovico and of course to Serena. I definitely will continue to learn and hope to come back to Bologna for more fun!

The reason I highly recommend Arca is that the class groups are really well made. Serafina and the teachers take the CEFR levels seriously. Because of this, we can build solid foundations instead of just superficial knowledge.
The teachers always prepare their lessons, and it shows! I also really appreciated that the teachers rotate every three weeks. I see this as essential: it lets you hear different ways of speaking, experience varied teaching styles, and sometimes it’s about personal affinity too!
I also had such a great time during the coffee breaks. The atmosphere was warm and fun, and it was a good opportunity to meet people from other classes :)

I’ve just completed two weeks of study at this extraordinary Italian language school in the heart of beautiful Bologna.  It’s been a joy from my first inquiry to the completion of my lessons today.  The directors and teachers are warm, helpful and most importantly, take a real interest in all of the students and their welfare and learning.  The level of teaching is exceptional and although I still have a distance to travel on my Italian language journey, it’s certainly had a kick start here at ARCA.  I plan to come back for longer next time!

I had a great time with my three months of classes at the school. It was nice to have students who were my age range between 40 and 65 as well as some younger students. The facility is beautiful and in a perfect location. Central in the city and very easy to get to either on foot or by public transportation. The teachers are amazing, thoughtful, professional, really well trained, and fun to work with. I highly recommend attending ItalianMe in Florence.

I just completed a week long enrollment in the ItalianMe language school in Florence, which was arranged by Melissa Muldoon of StudentessaMatta. I found the teachers and staff to be professional and most hospitable. I was placed in a B1 level class with 2 other students. Our teacher was excellent. While teaching from an Italian language text book, she allowed plenty of time for us to converse on different topics. She created detailed notes of each class which were emailed to us later that day. I believe my ability and confidence to converse in Italian, which was my goal, improved as a result of this class. I highly recommend the ItalianMe school to others wanting to improve their Italian language skills.

I recently took an Italian language course in Florence with ItalianMe, and it was an exceptional experience. The school offered small group classes, which ensured personalized attention and ample opportunities to practice speaking. The expert teachers were native speakers with deep knowledge of Italian culture and linguistics, blending grammar lessons with engaging discussions about local traditions, food, and history. Their passion and patience created a supportive environment, perfect for learners at any level.

Classes were dynamic, mixing interactive activities, real-life scenarios, and even short excursions to local museums to practice vocabulary. The small group size fostered a tight-knit community, making it easy to connect with classmates and learn collaboratively. By the end of the course, my confidence in speaking Italian had soared, and I felt immersed in Florentine life. Highly recommend this program for anyone seeking a culturally rich, effective way to learn Italian!
Maruchi Santana

I did four weeks of classes at italianme and highly recommend this school. The class sizes are not too big; the teachers are enthusiastic and patient; the atmosphere is very welcoming; and their teaching methods are very effective.
I am so glad I chose this particular language school and hope to return.

I spent a month with ItalianMe in Florence taking their beginners course - everything was great and I learned a ton! My instructor was Monica (who is beyond AMAZING) and I also opted in for additional cooking classes and private lessons. The school has afternoon activities with a variety of instructors, all were super helpful, kind, and patient. Highly recommend this program - I wish I had more time to stay and keep learning! It's also worth noting the other students were lovely - a diverse group with people at every age.
